description: Voice ID consent: grant and withdraw, with erasure on withdrawal.

preconditions: User consented and keeps own and collected samples plus machine suggestions pointing at them.
cases.inputs: actorId: a consented user with samples.
cases.return: Success with the profile showing no consent (MSG306 "Đã tắt nhận diện giọng nói và xoá toàn bộ giọng mẫu."); every sample and every suggestion pointing at the person is gone in the same write.
cases.log: Saved: samples and suggestions erased, consent closed; audit row records the withdrawal with the erased counts.

preconditions: User consented; the store fails while erasing.
cases.return: Failure SaveFailed (MSG315 "Không lưu được thay đổi. Vui lòng thử lại.").
cases.exception: PersistenceException is caught inside the service.
cases.log: Error logged with the user id.
